description: Returns one item, looked up by `itemId` or by the `collectionId` + `slug` pair (provide exactly one of the two). The `data` object is complete and schema-shaped: every currently-defined field is present and missing optional values read as `null`. `depth` (0–3, default 0) embeds referenced items in place of their ids, one level per unit; referenced items that were deleted read as `null` (single reference) or are omitted from arrays (multi-reference). Set `published` to `"true"` or `"false"` to match only a published or only a draft item (a mismatch reads as not found). List items that reference it with `cms.items.backreferences.list`.

collectionId.description: Collection to look the item up in by slug. Pair with `slug`.

itemId.description: Item id. Provide either this or the `collectionId` + `slug` pair.

published.description: Only match a published (`"true"`) or draft (`"false"`) item; a mismatch reads as not found. Omit to match either.

slug.description: Item slug within the collection. Pair with `collectionId`.

name: cms_items_get
title: Get an item
